messages:
maria_support: Janet from BrightCart reported sustained 429s for their dedicated pool during yesterday's 09:15-09:45 PST spike. They say scale never caught up and requests queued for ~30s.
aj_ops: looking — any repro logs from their side? rate, model, region?
customer_janet: region us-west-2, model: gpt-open-13b-quant, steady 120 rps over 5m, spikes to 400 rps. We saw 429s and warm pool never replenished.
maria_support: thanks. I pulled their autoscaler events — seeing repeated attach failures + imagepull backoff around 09:08.
ken_eng: paste of events snippet:

```
Warning FailedMount  pod/worker-xyz Failed to attach volume: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = attach denied for cluster-service-account
Warning BackOff    pod/worker-xyz Back-off pulling image "registry.internal/redwood-runtime:pt-2026-02"
```

ken_eng: service account rotation + registry auth failures happened during that window.
aj_ops: autoscaler logs show probe attempts but new nodes stuck in Pending for >3m because container images wouldn't start.
sre_bot: autoscaler-bot detected warmpool depletion: warm_pool_size=2 target_min=4 current_ready=1
maria_support: customer also reported a tenant on the same rack had an OOM eviction flood at 09:05 — could be noisy neighbor causing scheduler churn.
ken_eng: so two contributing factors: (1) imagepull/auth rotation preventing new pods from starting (2) scheduling pressure from evicted pods -> slow node provisioning.
aj_ops: repro steps I ran in staging:
1) rotate registry creds (simulate failed pulls)
2) create a noisy consumer that allocates 90% GPU memory on a node -> evictions
3) scale test client to burst 500 rps
Result: autoscaler triggered but pods remained Pending due to ImagePullBackOff + node churn. Latency and 429s match.
customer_janet: is there a short-term mitigation we can apply? This hit production hard.
ken_eng: short term options:
- increase min_replicas to maintain buffer (we recommended +2 for now)
- enable fallback routing to a hosted compatible model (we can flip to gpt-open-13b-quant-lite)
- temporarily allow pull-through cache on nodes (ops knob) to avoid registry auth dependency
aj_ops: applied min_replicas bump to 6 at 09:40; traffic dropped 429s within ~4m as some pods were already ready. fallback route enabled as a safety net.
maria_support: customer confirmed 429s cleared at ~09:44. They want a postmortem and permanent fix.
ken_eng: action items:
- investigate credential rotation pipeline that caused short-lived registry auth failures (owner: infra-auth)
- add autoscaler heuristic: if ImagePullBackOff > N for X secs, mark as pull-auth-failure and try warm pool warmup with cached images (owner: eng-platform)
- harden warm pool sizing recommendations for customers with spiky burst patterns (owner: customer-success)
aj_ops: also add a diagnostic flag in console: show "attach_fail" and "imagepull_backoff" counts per scale event so oncall can triage faster.
sre_bot: incident created: INC-2026-0456
customer_janet: thanks team — please keep me posted and advise if we should schedule a dedicated call.
maria_support: will follow up with detailed repro & timelines. cc @ken_eng for the auth timeline and @aj_ops for mitigations. :thumbsup
